response.justification: Bogdan’s extensive experience as a Senior Software Developer and Staff Engineer, combined with his deep expertise in TypeScript, React, Node.js, and cloud technologies (AWS, Kubernetes), strongly aligns with the fullstack role. His pragmatic approach to software architecture and passion for clean, testable code are clear strengths. While his background leans more senior than junior/mid-level, his adaptability and learning agility make him a compelling candidate.
strengths: Deep fullstack expertise with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and relational databases (MongoDB/SQL)
Proven track record in scalable systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes), and AI-agent infrastructure
Strong commitment to clean architecture, testing (TDD), and knowledge-sharing through workshops and open-source contributions
concerns: Overqualified for an entry-level role, which may lead to mismatched expectations or lack of long-term motivation
Limited direct experience with PostgreSQL (primarily MongoDB and SQL)
High on-site presence requirement may not align with Bogdan’s current remote-friendly roles (e.g., re:cinq)
